=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:removed is_sensitive_target_path / MAX_TARGET_PATHS (was 152-172); normalize_path at 241-245; emit_context at 568-579 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path rejection was removed, allowing plan- or issue-derived paths to read credential files such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, `.aws`, `.netrc`, and `.pypirc` into model prompts.
  WHY: `normalize_path` no longer filters sensitive paths before filesystem access, exposing workspace secrets to the model provider.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:emit_context at lines 536-716 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` limits were removed and headers, missing-file markers, and overflow markers do not advance `used_bytes`.
  WHY: An untrusted path list can produce output substantially larger than `max_bytes`, exhausting Codex stdin or context budgets.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url at lines 3040-3052; _resolve_origin_url at lines 3077-3083 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication boundary was replaced with URLs containing `https://x-access-token:TOKEN@host/...`.
  WHY: Git command arguments, `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, remote configuration, diagnostics, and logs can expose the live GitHub token.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:_memory_force_tick_remote_url at lines 578-585 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` embeds the token in the force-tick remote URL.
  WHY: Downstream clone, `ls-remote`, and push commands expose the token through argv, `/proc`, Git diagnostics, and remote URLs.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:line 665-672 (codex invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose Codex invocation changed from brokered read-only execution to direct `--sandbox danger-full-access` execution with workflow credentials.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content can read, modify, and exfiltrate workspace data, `GH_TOKEN`, and `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:lines 1-140 (entire file; the model_provider_broker_* family spanning roughly lines 142-525 of the prior file was deleted) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker lifecycle, preparation, execution, ACL, and `--provider-base-url` support were deleted while unchanged callers remain.
  WHY: Codex phases fail with command-not-found errors and lose the credential-isolation boundary.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:usage line 7, parser lines 49-54, run_without_guard lines 26-30, Python guard lines 127-132 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` parsing and the associated process-group metadata and supervision helpers were removed.
  WHY: `scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:553` still passes the option, causing an unknown-option failure before the editor starts and removing isolated process-group cleanup.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh:lines 229-237, 287-323, 331-351, 367-372, 412-418, 435-462 (cleanup paths) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Process-group identity verification, survivor checks, isolated-group verification, and the privileged kill path were removed.
  WHY: Bare `os.killpg` can signal an unrelated process after PID reuse, while orphan descendants can survive the wrapper.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:lines 493-498 (git_with_github_auth deleted), lines 953-1351 (review_blocked_decision_digest, review_blocked_find_pending_request, review_blocked_build_approval_request, review_blocked_approval_status, review_blocked_post_approval_request, review_blocked_post_consumed_marker, review_blocked_find_issue_for_request, review_blocked_build_successor_intent, review_blocked_successor_marker, review_blocked_ensure_successor_intent, review_blocked_resolve_successor_issue, review_blocked_prepare_successor_issue deleted) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the review-blocked approval/successor helper family were deleted without caller migration.
  WHY: `review_rb_judge.sh` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` invoke the removed functions, breaking approval, merge, close-and-reissue, successor-issue, and authenticated baseline operations.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:lines 730-839 (REST _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest) and lines 833-924 (GraphQL gh_pr_with_all_comments) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR comments no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer and approver authentication cannot bind trusted authors or reject untrusted comments.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:usage line 86, parser lines 95-148, default + writer line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` parsing and validation were removed and the base URL is hardcoded to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Unchanged callers fail on the unknown argument, and the loopback broker URL cannot be supplied.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:lines 137-183 (memory_ensure_branch uses direct git ls-remote/push), lines 542-606 (_memory_force_tick_remote_url), lines 767-773, 883-889, 919-925 (memory_force_tick_get/put use direct git clone/push); the _memory_git wrapper is deleted | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Memory Git operations now use bare Git commands after `_memory_git` authentication was removed.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, branch bootstrap, clone, and force-tick operations cannot authenticate and fail open with ai-memory unavailable.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:Configure git auth step at 68-81; persist-credentials: false at 43 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` and `http.extraHeader` are configured only within one step and are not written to `GITHUB_ENV`.
  WHY: Later memory-helper Git operations inherit an unauthenticated origin.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:lines 137-183 (memory_ensure_branch), 542-606, 767-773, 883-889, 919-925 (force-tick path) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Memory Git failures fall through `_memory_warn` fail-open branches without reporting an error to the workflow.
  WHY: Ai-memory reads and writes silently no-op when credentials are absent, so later phases cannot trust the memory record.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 98-237 (staged-support restore block) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block requires `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but `implement.yml` does not create or export them.
  WHY: The protection is dead code and implement runs can overwrite branch-owned helper changes with `SCRIPT_REF` copies.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:lines 199-203 (git merge-file invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `git merge-file` receives the editor, support baseline, and HEAD in the wrong current/other/base order.
  WHY: The merge uses HEAD as the base instead of the support baseline, which can drop branch-side edits when the files diverge.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:lines 29-38 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test module still imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were removed.
  WHY: Pytest collection fails with `ImportError` before targeted-file-context tests run.
- scripts/implement_handle_guard_block.sh:lines 12-76 (new SSB_REASON branch) | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new `SSB_REASON` branch labels, comments, and alerts unconditionally without validating that `SSB_REASON` and `SSB_FILES` were wired consistently.
  WHY: Partial wiring can apply a stale `ai:needs-human` latch and alert without supporting files, leaving no recovery path.
